title: The Machine of Halcyon Drift
author: Kestrel Lockridge
blurb: Cyrus Marchetti, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
